causal_path: The common OS lock serializes mutating lease owners. pending() and prerequisites_busy() intentionally read without that lock. While owner writes QUEUED, the read probe observes its rollback journal; actual SQLite COMMIT removes it before private file open. Old code reports STATE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE/unknown. This is a false failure, not an exclusion bypass.
fix: Use a shared private-open checker. Ignore FileNotFoundError only for -journal/-wal/-shm. Main may be absent only during explicit domain initialization; existing read/write connections cannot recreate it. Existing owner/mode/type/link guards remain. Apply same checker to registered journal preflight because cooperative cancellation can write those journals without the common lease.
